svg.text: K8S LLM AUTOSCALING & COLD-START OPTIMIZATION: KEDA QUEUE/KV METRICS & WEIGHT STREAMING
KEDA Queue/KV Triggers + NVMe GDS / Run:ai Weight Streamer Cuts Cold Start 51.2x (640s -> 12.5s)
70B LLM Elastic Pool: Tier 1 HPA on GPU_UTIL + 140GB Image (640s Boot) vs. Tier 3 Run:ai Streamer (24s) vs. Tier 4 GDS+Sleep (12.5s)
⛔ Tier 1 Traps: Why `GPU_UTIL` HPA & Fat Images Fail
1. The `DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL = 95%` Autoscaling Illusion:
• `GPU_UTIL` only measures whether >=1 SM warp is active! A pod
at `B=2` (`5%` KV full) and a pod at `B=128` (`100%` KV full) BOTH
report `~95%` GPU_UTIL—causing `72%` false/late scaling!
2. Baking 140GB Model Weights into Docker/OCI Images (`640s` Boot):
• Pulling & unpacking a 140GB tar layer + single-thread `mmap`
takes `10.7 minutes`—the traffic spike is over before Pod is Ready!
Tier 1 Naive K8s HPA + Fat Image Failure Impact:
• Scale-Out Pod Ready Time: 640 sec (10.7 minutes!)
• Burst P99 TTFT: 18,500 ms (18.5s queue stall)
• Monthly Elastic Cluster TCO: $245,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: KEDA Queue/KV Triggers + GDS & Sleep-Wake
1. Golden KEDA Autoscaling Metrics (`Waiting Queue` & `KV Usage`):
• Scale out when `vllm:num_requests_waiting > 4` OR
`vllm:gpu_cache_usage_perc > 0.78` (30s stabilization window!)
2. `Run:ai Model Streamer` / Local NVMe `GPUDirect Storage (GDS)`:
• Streams `70 GB` FP8 `.safetensors` in parallel chunks directly
into GPU HBM at `28 GB/s` (`2.5s` weight load, `24s` cold pod!)
3. `vLLM Sleep Mode (level=1)` Host-DRAM Warm Standby (`4.2s` Wake):
• Offloads idle replica weights to Pinned Host DDR5 & wakes in `4.2s`!
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Scale-Out Ready Time: 12.5 sec (-51.2x faster than Tier 1!)
• Burst P99 TTFT: 540 ms | False-Scaling Rate: Only 0.4%
• Monthly Elastic Cluster TCO: $88,000 / mo (-64.1% savings)
